title: Animated Scenes - Float And Watch The Stars - 4K
description:
I originally wrote this song in 2024. It was released as a slow song. I always loved this melody and wanted to try something completely different with it. This song makes me feel so good when listening in my car and driving for some reason. It's way different than my usual music. The video took a while to create. I animated all of the images in VEO3 then created transitions using Pika keyframes. They aren't perfect but it mostly worked. Hope you enjoy it. 

Float And Watch The Stars

Verse 1:
The night whispers secrets, soft and slow
We drift like shadows, where dreams go
Stars above are more than light
They hold our hearts in quiet flight
 
Chorus:
Why don't we just float and watch the stars?
Why don't we just float and watch the stars?
 
Verse 2:
We move through silence, calm and clear
Time fades away, no need to steer
The world below feels far and small
In this stillness, we have it all
 
Chorus:
Why don't we just float and watch the stars?
Why don't we just float and watch the stars?
 
Bridge:
The sky unfolds, a quiet sigh
We float in peace, you and I
No weight to hold, no need to run
We watch the stars until we’re one
 
Chorus (outro):
Why don't we just float and watch the stars?
Why don't we just float and watch the stars?
We’ll float forever, watching the stars.

Lyrics written by me, Kelly Boesch. Music created under my creative direction with assistance from Suno.
